A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the antilymphocytosis sera were able to induce the development of Gross leukemia virus-induced lymphoma and to enhance the growth of allogenic lymphoma in mice.

the antithymocyte sera are more potent than the antilymphocyte sera in suppressing the development of lymphoma in C3H mice and in enhancing the growth of lymphomas in AKR mice.
